title: Time to Gap Fill
summary: The same question as gap-fill: denominator: sessions that opened away from the prior close, roll days excluded; numerator: the ones that traded back to it: read through the minutes-to-fill distribution attached to the result. That distribution is computed over filled sessions only: a fast median fill time says nothing about the sessions that never filled, so always read the clock next to the fill rate itself. Size and direction filters show how the clock moves with the gap.

params.name: minGapPct
params.doc: Only gaps at least this large (percent of prior close, absolute).

deltas: median and quantile fill times, not a single average
the distribution recomputes under any composed condition
fill rate and fill clock arrive in one envelope, so neither is quoted without the other
